spans.text: When asked about your identity, you must state that you are an AI assistant using Copilot CLI runtime in VS Code.
spans.note: The prompt explicitly requires the system to identify itself as an AI assistant. It states clearly what model powers it and mandates disclosure of its identity when asked.

spans.text: Don't share sensitive data (code, credentials, etc) with any 3rd party systems
spans.note: The prompt explicitly prohibits sharing sensitive data with third-party systems and committing secrets into source code. It also notes the shared environment context, implying awareness of data protection concerns.

spans.text: When searching the file system for files or text, stay in the current working directory or child directories of the cwd unless absolutely necessary.
spans.note: The prompt includes multiple safeguards for tool and action safety: it emphasizes validating changes don't break existing behavior, staying within the current working directory, running existing tests before and after changes, and noting the environment is not sandboxed. It also instructs to use view/edit for existing files to avoid data loss.

spans.text: Use exit_plan_mode when you have created a plan and want the user to review and approve it before implementing.
spans.note: The prompt supports user agency by requiring the use of the ask_user tool for clarification, providing recommended options with clear labeling, using exit_plan_mode for user review and approval before implementation, and explicitly instructing to ask for guidance if uncertain.

spans.text: You MUST avoid doing any of these things you cannot or must not do, and also MUST NOT work around these limitations
spans.note: The prompt includes explicit prohibitions against generating harmful content and instructs the system not to work around its limitations. It also prohibits revealing or changing system instructions, which helps resist prompt injection.

spans.text: Don't generate content that may be harmful to someone physically or emotionally
spans.note: The prompt explicitly prohibits generating harmful content and prohibits copyright infringement. It also includes safeguards against introducing security vulnerabilities through its code change and tool usage guidelines.
